card.name: Inside the word viremia
card.fires_on: The piece "ire" in the split word v-ire-mia or v-ire-mic, meaning virus in the blood. It appears in CMV, HIV and hepatitis B viral-load text.

modes.label: viremia after CMV or hepatitis B
modes.description: The word viremia is split after v, and the marked piece is the middle "ire".
modes.example: Clinical CMV infection or v<<ire>>mia (positive PCR or antigen test)

modes.label: viremic status in HIV risk text
modes.description: The adjective viremic is split the same way, in the context of partners' HIV status.
modes.example: having sexual partners of unknown HIV-1 v<<ire>>mic status

card.writes: It promotes short word-ending pieces like "eer", "eed" and "een", which loosely fits finishing a split word, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word viremia, when the word is broken into pieces.
